goal: Allow running a full transaction index on pruned nodes without storing the entire raw block history on disk
Return candidate block hashes so RPC callers can fetch missing pruned blocks via getblockfrompeer
Allow getrawtransaction verbosity 2 to omit missing fee and prevout data instead of failing when undo data is gone
agreement: Strong support across reviewers, with major objections on race conditions and test failures resolved
Tested reindexing on pruned nodes and verified edge cases (optout21)
Concept approval for significantly improving the utility and lookup reach of pruned nodes (ajtowns, arejula27, optout21)
Nonblocking suggestion: report pruned block hash in gettxoutproof when tx has unspent outputs (arejula27)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it unlocks full transaction index functionality on pruned nodes, resolving multiple longstanding issues
Pruned node operators can maintain a complete transaction lookup index without keeping hundreds of gigabytes of blocks

why: P2 because it provides structured error data with candidate block hashes so callers can fetch missing blocks
